subject: Pen test methodology, firm credentials, and report validity
messages:
From: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: infosec@acme-retail.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Hi Karthik,

Quick questions from Acme InfoSec as we work up procurement for Redwood: 1) What methodology and standards did the most recent penetration test use (e.g., OWASP Top 10, PTES, CREST)? 2) Who performed the test and can you share firm credentials/assessor ISO certifications? 3) Our policy accepts pen test reports up to 12 months old if remediation is tracked — your latest report is dated 2025-09-20. Will that be acceptable or do you require a fresh engagement before contract sign? 4) Can you confirm scope (internet-facing, internal, API, onboarding workflows) and whether exploit PoCs are included or redacted?

We can sign an NDA for a redacted report if needed.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Reynolds
Senior Security Manager | Acme Retail
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Dana — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then details: 1) Methodology: OWASP Top 10 + PTES-style web app and API assessment; the scope included authenticated and unauthenticated tests for public services. 2) Firm: SentinelBridge Security (mobile/infra team) — we can provide their company creds and assessor CVs. 3) Report validity: yes, our last full pen test report is 2025-09-20. We accept a 12-month-old report for procurement if we provide a remediation attestation and tracked tickets; if you require a fresh test, we can schedule a targeted re-test. 4) Scope: focus was on internet-facing production services, public API endpoints, and the customer onboarding flow. Internal network testing was out of scope for that engagement. PoCs: we provide exploit descriptions and reproduction steps in the full report; redacted version removes sensitive PoCs but keeps findings and risk ratings.

I'll attach a redacted summary and the firm creds. If Acme needs the full report we can share it under NDA — I can send the NDA as the next step. If you want, we can also propose a statement of work (SOW) and timeline for a focused retest of any components you care about.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer — Security
Redwood Inference
From: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: infosec@acme-retail.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Thanks, Karthik — helpful. A couple of follow-ups: a) On the remediation attestation, can you provide ticket IDs (e.g., Jira or GitHub) and dates for critical/high findings fixed since 2025-09? b) For the PoCs, our procurement prefers a redacted report first and full report under NDA — that works. c) For scope: can you confirm whether customer-managed private deployments (on-prem / VPC) were covered or only Redwood-hosted instances?

If you can get the redacted PDF and firm creds by Monday we can move this into legal review.

-Dana
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Dana — looping in a couple notes from our security and product teams: 1) Remediation tracking: attached is a short attestation plus a list of internal ticket refs (redacted IDs) and closure dates for all critical/high items from the 2025-09 engagement. We will provide full ticket links to your security contact after an NDA is executed. 2) Scope: the 2025 test covered Redwood-hosted production only. Private/VPC/on-prem deployments are not included in that engagement; we can do a scoped assessment for customer-managed deployments as a separate SOW. 3) Firm creds: attached. 4) Cadence: we run an annual full engagement and targeted retests (post-remediation) as needed — some customers request a 6–9 month targeted retest for major changes.

We'll attach the redacted report and an NDA to this thread. If Acme would like a timeline for a customer-specific retest, tell us which assets you want in scope and we can return a proposed SOW and ETA within 3 business days.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: infosec@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Marissa — appreciate the details. Action items for Acme: 1) We'll review the redacted PDF and firm creds in legal. 2) Regarding remediation evidence, redacted ticket refs are fine for initial review; we will ask for full links under NDA. 3) For scope we will ask vendor management whether they require customer-managed deployments included in the first 12 months — likely not, but we'll confirm.

One procurement note: our security policy has a hard-stop at 12 months for any public-facing SaaS provider. Since Redwood's report is 2025-09-20, it's within the window, but we will want the remediation attestation and the list of critical/high fixes to be attached to the contract.

Please send the NDA and redacted report when ready and I will push this through legal.

Thanks,
Dana
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Dana Reynolds <dana.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test questions — methodology, cadence, and report age

Dana — attached: 1) Redacted pen test summary (Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2025-09-redacted.pdf) 2) SentinelBridge firm creds (Redwood_PenTest_Firm_Credentials.pdf) 3) NDA (NDA_Redwood.pdf)

Quick clarifications to support legal: — We confirm the 2025-09-20 report used OWASP Top 10 and PTES-style controls for web/API assessments. — SentinelBridge is CREST-aligned and two primary assessors are OSCP/OSCE certified; credentials are in the attached PDF. — We have a tracked remediation attestation in the attachment; critical/high items from 2025-09 were closed between 2025-10-05 and 2025-12-18 (ticket refs redacted).

Next steps: sign the NDA and we will provide full report access and ticket links. If Acme would prefer Redwood to commission a fresh customer-scoped retest, we can return an SOW and timeline within 3 business days after you share a list of assets.

Regards,
Karthik
